description: This PHP source file defines the SoapHelperWebServices class, which provides methods for handling SOAP API operations in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for user validation, field retrieval, relationship management, ACL checks, and other SOAP-related functionalities.

classes.name: SoapHelperWebServices
classes.description: A class providing SOAP API helper methods for SuiteCRM, including user validation, record retrieval and manipulation, relationship handling, ACL checks, and utility functions.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions for a module, including labels, types, and relationship info.

methods.name: setFaultObject
methods.description: Sets an error object in the service, with optional debug logging.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Validates user credentials, establishing a session if valid.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates and loads a user session based on session ID.

methods.name: is_valid_ip_address
methods.description: Checks if the client's IP address matches the session's recorded IP, for security.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Verifies user session validity and module access permissions.

methods.name: checkACLAccess
methods.description: Verifies ACL permissions for a given bean and view type.

methods.name: checkQuery
methods.description: Validates SQL query clauses for security.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Utility to create a name/value pair array.

methods.name: get_user_module_list
methods.description: Returns the list of modules accessible to a user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to a specific module with provided action level.

methods.name: get_name_value_list
methods.description: Returns a list of name/value pairs representing record fields.

methods.name: filter_fields
methods.description: Filters a list of fields based on accessibility and source restrictions.

methods.name: get_name_value_list_for_fields
methods.description: Generates name/value list for specified fields of a record.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_list
methods.description: Converts an array to an array of name/value pairs.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_lists
methods.description: Converts an array to nested name/value pairs.

methods.name: name_value_lists_get_array
methods.description: Converts a list of name/value entries into a nested associative array.

methods.name: array_get_return_value
methods.description: Constructs a return structure for a record, including ID, module, and name/value list.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_fields
methods.description: Prepares a record's data with specified fields for SOAP response.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Fetches related records for a primary bean based on relationship link.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_link_fields
methods.description: Returns related link data for a bean in SOAP format.

methods.name: new_handle_set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or deletes relationships between records.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Creates new records from provided name/value lists.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Returns a record's ID, module, and name/value list suitable for SOAP response.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves module fields and links with optional translation.

methods.name: login_success
methods.description: Sets user language and session preferences after successful login.

methods.name: checkSaveOnNotify
methods.description: Checks if notifications should be sent on save.

methods.name: add_create_account
methods.description: Creates or associates an account with a contact.

methods.name: check_for_duplicate_contacts
methods.description: Detects duplicate contacts based on email and last name.

methods.name: decrypt_string
methods.description: Decrypts a string using TripleDES, likely for secure password handling.

methods.name: isLogLevelDebug
methods.description: Checks if the logging level is set to debug.
